top1.title: 【2026-10-19】ディズニー、経営破綻のCharacter.AI従業員の過半数に採用提示へ
top1.lead1: ディズニーが、経営破綻したCharacter.AIの従業員60人以上に採用を提示することで合意したとTechCrunchが報じました。
top1.lead2: 裁判所提出書類では、提示を受けた従業員の大多数が受諾。ただし、他社がより高い買収条件を提示する可能性が残っています。

top10.title: [2026-10-19] Disney to offer jobs to more than half of bankrupt Character.AI's employees
top10.summary: According to court filings, Disney has agreed to offer jobs to more than 60 Character.AI employees. The vast majority have accepted, but a higher offer from another company could still change the deal.

top10.title: [2026-10-19] Woman arrested for obstructing delivery robot in Philadelphia, US, says she was protesting job losses
top10.summary: A woman was arrested after blocking an Uber delivery robot's path and refusing police requests to move. She says she was protesting the loss of jobs for human delivery workers.
